concept: India's first AI-powered Football Operating System. Gamer-grade, football-culture-first. Tactical, athletic, high-visibility.

fifa_tiers.toty: bg-gradient-to-br from-[#00E5FF] via-[#0055FF] to-[#001133] border-2 border-[#00E5FF] text-white shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,229,255,0.5)]

scale.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-display uppercase
scale.h2: text-3xl md:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-none font-display uppercase
scale.h3: text-2xl md:text-3xl tracking-tight leading-none font-display uppercase

typography.rules: Never use Inter/Roboto. Use Bebas Neue for all major headlines and player overall ratings. Use JetBrains Mono for all numeric stats, timers, and attributes.

spacing_and_layout.surface_strategy: Tactical Minimalism. 1px solid borders (`border-border`). No soft drop shadows. Use inner glows or sharp 4px hard shadows for elevated elements. Elements should feel like a command center.

buttons.primary: bg-brand-primary text-white font-bold uppercase tracking-wider h-12 px-6 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors hover:bg-[#D63026]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-border text-white font-bold uppercase tracking-wider h-12 px-6 hover:border-brand-primary hover:text-brand-primary

cards.default: bg-background-card border border-border p-4 hover:border-brand-primary/50 transition-colors
cards.player_card: relative overflow-hidden p-6 flex flex-col items-center justify-center border border-border aspect-[2/3]

components.inputs: bg-background-default border border-border h-12 px-4 text-white focus:border-brand-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand-primary outline-none font-body
components.bottom_nav: fixed bottom-0 w-full h-16 bg-background-elevated border-t border-border flex justify-around items-center z-50 pb-safe

login_onboarding.layout: Full-height flex column. Hero background image with gradient overlay (to-black).
login_onboarding.features: Phone/Email input, OTP. Role selection (Player / Coach) using large image cards. Minimal form, high visual impact.

home_tab.features: Social feed with text messages. Post UI with custom reactions (boot, gloves, whistle, fire, 100). Sticky header with app logo. Floating Action Button (FAB) for 'Create Match'.

matches_tab.features: Create Match flow (Team -> Opponent -> Slot -> Pay -> Confirm). Match cards showing teams, date, venue. Past matches show 'View Stats'.

feed_tab.features: Text posts, community discussions, friend activity. Distinct from Home tab which might be more curated.

explore_tab.features: Grid items: Coach, Teams, Partners, Leaderboard, Drills, Events, Turfs, Trophies, Tournaments. Each square has a distinct monochrome icon and tight spacing.

profile_tab.features: Large Digital Player Card (FIFA-style) showing OVR, PAC/SHO/PAS/DRI/DEF/PHY. XP progress bar under card. Stats section (Goals, Assists). Match consistency graph.

admin_dashboard.layout: Desktop-optimized sidebar + main content area. 'Control Room' grid.
admin_dashboard.features: Data tables for Users/Turfs/Matches. Manual creation forms for Turfs/Referees/Coaches. No 'Reports' option.

match_control_var.features: Schedule click -> Camera auto-starts at turf. Large central video feed (simulated multi-angle). Control panel: Kickoff, Foul, Goal, Yellow Card, Red Card, Offside, Match Complete. Offside auto-detect notification UI.

live_broadcast_viewer.features: Live overlay of score and time (top band). Timeline events appearing as lower-thirds when goals/fouls occur.

performance_analysis.features: Pitch heatmap visualization. Player performance stats using JetBrains Mono. AI-generated text summary box.

motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Instant or very fast fade. Athletic interfaces don't waste time with slow staggers.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Active buttons click-down (scale-95). Data numbers should count-up on load.
motion_and_interactions.special_fx: XP Toast slides in sharply from top. Card tier upgrade (e.g., Silver -> Gold) uses a bright flare effect and confetti.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Use ARIA labels on all custom reaction buttons.

icons.style: Use 2px stroke, sharp icons. For custom reactions (boot, gloves, whistle) use SVG paths or emojis if custom SVGs are not provided.

hero_stadium_login.description: Night stadium hero image for login/onboarding background

turf_placeholder.description: Green turf texture for turf booking cards

action_shot_1.description: Player action shot for feed posts or explore headers

action_shot_2.description: Dynamic player motion for promotional cards

instructions_to_main_agent: Read this entire JSON before implementing.
The app MUST be in Dark Mode only. No light mode toggle.
Do not use generic purple/violet tech SaaS colors. Stick to the bold Black/White/Red/Neon athletic palette defined in colors.
Typography is critical: Bebas Neue for headings, JetBrains Mono for stats, DM Sans for text. Import these from Google Fonts.
All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`).
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them to remove the 'Vercel look' - remove border radius, make borders 1px solid, remove soft shadows.
Ensure 5-tab bottom navigation is fixed at the bottom for mobile views (Home, Matches, Feed, Explore, Profile).
Admin and VAR interfaces are desktop-first 'Control Rooms' with dense data layouts.
